disorder-name.detail: Autism Spectrum Disorders; clinical cohort evaluated with normative modeling of cortical thickness asymmetry

dataset-of-origin.detail: ASD data from 7 sites across 5 datasets: ABIDE-I (NYU, USM sites), ABIDE-II (GU, OHSU sites), MITASD, WASHASD, MADRID-ASD (labeled ERANET in Supplemental Figure 1). MITASD, WASHASD, and MADRID-ASD are not in the normalized keyword list.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The ABIDE-I and ABIDE-II datasets include low quality T1 data which biases cortical thickness measurements (Bedford et al., 2023)."
dataset-of-origin.location: Echave2024.pdf.md: Methods / Image processing, L81; Echave2024_sup.docx.md: Supplemental Table 2, L59-L82

age.detail: Per-disorder age statistics not separately reported in available text. Combined case range (ASD + SZ) is 7-65 years. Detailed per-site demographics referenced in Supplemental Table 1, which is not available in provided materials.
age.supporting_text: "The age range encompassed the age range of the cases (range: 7-65 years)."

sex.detail: N=135, 83% male reported. Exact counts estimated: male_n = round(135 * 0.83) = 112; female_n = 135 - 112 = 23. Counts are derived from reported percentage.
sex.supporting_text: "The clinical sample comprised 135 individuals with ASD (83% male)"

disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia; clinical cohort evaluated with normative modeling of cortical thickness asymmetry. Paper abbreviates as SZ.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "schizophrenia (SZ)"; "The clinical sample comprised ... 287 individuals with SZ (81% male)"
disorder-name.location: Echave2024.pdf.md: Abstract, L45; Methods / Sample characteristics, L77

dataset-of-origin.detail: SZ data from 3 sites: BGS, COBRE, and Utrecht. BGS is not in the normalized keyword list. COBRE and Utrecht are normalized keywords.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The BGS and COBRE datasets have undergone extensive quality control procedures (Chopra et al., 2023)"; "For the Utrecht dataset images also underwent extensive quality control and we initially included the same images as (Janssen et al., 2021)."

age.detail: Per-disorder age statistics not separately reported in available text. Combined case range (ASD + SZ) is 7-65 years. Detailed per-site demographics referenced in Supplemental Table 1, which is not available in provided materials.
age.supporting_text: "The age range encompassed the age range of the cases (range: 7-65 years)."

sex.detail: N=287, 81% male reported. Exact counts estimated: male_n = round(287 * 0.81) = 232; female_n = 287 - 232 = 55. Counts are derived from reported percentage. 232/287 = 80.8%, which rounds to 81% as reported in paper.
sex.supporting_text: "The clinical sample comprised ... 287 individuals with SZ (81% male)"
